files.description: Fix TypeScript type error at the sort comparator by typing the sort key as a union of valid sortable item fields (e.g. `type SortKey = 'name' | 'price' | 'quantity' | 'category' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'`), validating the incoming sort query param against that union (falling back to a default like 'name' if invalid) before using it to index items in a[sort]/b[sort] on both comparator branches, so the collection GET/POST endpoints and item-level PUT/DELETE logic in this handler type-check and build successfully.
